text: Make producer progress visible during the stage. Record periodic progress events (tool calls and files changed) to the job's records. Flag a producer with no progress for a set interval as stalled, and end it early with a stall reason instead of waiting out the full deadline. Keep the partial workspace diff so the job can be diagnosed. Add a test with a fake producer that stalls. This is separate from the queued item on how deadline overruns are recorded.
